name: pramoxine
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of pain and itching associated with fever blisters and cold sores
otcwarn: Stop use and consult a doctor If Redness Swelling Irritation or pain persists or increases, condition worsens, or if symptoms persist for more than 7 days or clear up and occur again within a few days, discontinue use of this product and consult a doctor.
